title.zh: 【Hifi Finance 遭 DAO 治理夺权，约 100 万美元用户抵押资产被转走】
title.en: 【Hifi Finance 遭 DAO 治理夺权，约 100 万美元用户抵押资产被转走】

current_state.zh: Hifi Finance suffered a DAO governance takeover in which a Tornado Cash-funded attacker swung four last-minute votes, seized control, minted 25 million governance tokens and siphoned roughly $1 million in user collateral.
current_state.en: Hifi Finance suffered a DAO governance takeover in which a Tornado Cash-funded attacker swung four last-minute votes, seized control, minted 25 million governance tokens and siphoned roughly $1 million in user collateral.
